question:
Many people work long hours, leaving very little time for leisure activities.
Does this situation have more advantages or more disadvantages?
essay:
Nowadays, jobs play a crucial role in people’s life, a large number of people work long hours, and they spend little time doing fun and other leisure activities. this situation has some process and cons for people.

working long hours benefits people in some ways. first of all, if people work more,  they will earn more money. as a case in  point, some workers of factories work assiduously  more than business hours and get more money. they can spend extra money on their families and this is spending money acts as a catalyst for fortifying  the relationship between family members. further to this, the number of Job opportunities  at different Fields and Levels has increased over the past few years. it is clear that working long hours is positively correlated with gaining experience. such experience opens Avenues  for getting promotion and wider success.

on the other hand, longer work has two disadvantages. first, if individuals work long hours, not only will there morale be low,  but also it will make them feel depressed. in this conditions Doing leisure activities gives them the perfect chance to rejuvenate. furthermore, working long hours may damage workers’ health, physically. for example,labours working with machines at  nightshift or exhausted admit night, and in this situation, they may make a mistake and hurt themselves.

To conclude, even though working long hours has some advantages such as earning more money, improving the relationship  between family Members and getting promotion, it has some disadvantages like feeling depressed and damaging their health.  from my point of view, the advantages easily outweigh the disadvantages.
